title: FPSRG: Heterogeneous User Simulation First-Person Post-Training and Multidimensional Semantic Response Grids
abstract: arXiv:2611.16445v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Simulating heterogeneous individuals with large language models is an active research direction, and heterogeneous user simulation requires models with different characteristics. We study profile construction: given dimensions, items, and scoring rules, build model configurations that can be retrieved by multidimensional target scores. We introduce First-Person Semantic Response Grids (FPSRG). Shared post-training first teaches the model to judge and answer as the participant; self-report and behavioral targets then refine dimension-specific control vectors. With the model frozen, we measure joint scores for vector-coefficient combinations, filter inadmissible configurations, and store the results in a searchable catalog. Per-token configuration routing, continuous batching, and isolated caches support parallel measurement of different profiles. translated_title: FPSRG：面向异质用户模拟的第一人称后训练与多维语义响应网格
translated_abstract: 用大语言模型模拟异质个体是一个活跃的研究方向，异质用户模拟需要具有不同特征的模型。我们研究画像构建问题：在给定维度、条目和评分规则的情况下，构建能够通过多维目标分数进行检索的模型配置。我们提出了第一人称语义响应网格。共享后训练首先教会模型以参与者的身份进行判断和作答；随后利用自我报告和行为目标来细化针对特定维度的控制向量。在模型冻结的情况下，我们测量各向量-系数组合的联合分数，过滤掉不可接受的配置，并将结果存储在可搜索的目录中。逐词元配置路由、连续批处理和隔离缓存支持对不同画像的并行测量。非思考模式的五维和十维Qwen实例以及思考模式的六维实例……
tldr: 该论文提出FPSRG方法，通过第一人称后训练使模型以参与者身份作答，再利用维度特定控制向量构建可按多维目标分数检索的模型配置目录，从而实现大语言模型的高效异质用户模拟。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes FPSRG, which uses first-person post-training to make models judge and answer as participants, then refines dimension-specific control vectors to build a searchable catalog of model configurations retrievable by multidimensional target scores for efficient heterogeneous user simulation.
